description: This file is a server-side module for a contacts list page in a SvelteKit application. It handles data fetching from a Django REST API, data transformation, and CRUD actions (create, update, delete) for contacts. It uses specific API endpoints and handles various response formats, indicating a customized integration between Django and the frontend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Main server-side load function that fetches and processes contact data, accounts, tags, and prepares data for the frontend.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new contact via POST request to the API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing contact via PATCH request to the API.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a contact via DELETE request to the API.
